comments.author: Martin Isola
comments.body:
Hi Team,
Please review the point clouds carefully and model this project with the highest level of accuracy possible, matching the point cloud exactly as captured.
Also, please keep Huw's comment in mind during modeling:
"Their primary concern is the approx 4 inch gap at the bottom of the banister between the plywood and stairs. Also the steel at top and bottom of stairs."
A few important notes:
Each staircase should be modeled in a separate Revit file.

Pay special attention to tolerances and ensure the model reflects the scanned conditions as accurately as possible.

Once the first staircase is complete, perform a thorough QC review before moving forward.

Please verify the tolerance using CloudCompare or QBitect. If possible, target a tolerance of ±1/2".

After QC is complete and the tolerance has been confirmed, deliver the first model so we can obtain client feedback before proceeding with the remaining staircases.

Thank you. Let’s make sure this one is as precise as possible.

Thanks for the clarification.
I'll discuss this with the team. My main concern is the partially completed state of the staircases. Regarding the deliverables, to avoid complicating communication and version control, it might be better for us to issue a partial delivery first and then a final delivery once everything is complete, rather than releasing each model individually as they are finished.
